description: This Java source file defines the class DelegatedCommandSenderImpl, which implements the DelegatedCommandSender interface. It provides methods to send command messages over AMQP protocol, utilizing Vert.x and Proton libraries for messaging and OpenTracing for distributed tracing. The class includes methods for creating command messages, sending them with callbacks or futures, handling timeouts, and tracing spans.

classes.name: DelegatedCommandSenderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DelegatedCommandSender that sends command messages over AMQP with tracing and timeout handling.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint URL for the command sender, specifically a constant indicating the northbound command legacy endpoint.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Executes sending a message and waits for the delivery outcome, used internally.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for its delivery outcome, creating tracing span.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Overloaded method that accepts a parent span context for tracing, sends a raw message.

methods.name: runSendAndWaitForOutcomeOnContext
methods.description: Executes send operation within the connection context, handles backpressure and errors.

methods.name: sendMessageAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message, waits for the delivery update, handles timeouts, and manages tracing.

methods.name: sendCommandMessage
methods.description: Creates a delegated command message, sets tracing tags, and sends it, returning a future for the outcome.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Builds the exact target address for a given tenant and device.

methods.name: createDelegatedCommandMessage
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the original message and sets the reply-to address for delegated commands.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new DelegatedCommandSender with a configured AMQP sender, targetting a specific tenant and device.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts a new tracing span for delegating command requests, associating it with parent span context.
